method: MFCC (13 + deltas, CMN) + DTW (Sakoe-Chiba band 0.2, length-normalised), src/engine/templates.ts

arabic.dataset: Arabic Speech Commands v1.0, 30 speakers x 40 words x 10 repeats, 1 s clips at 16 kHz

split.note: Thresholds chosen on dev speakers (random-10 lists) only; all figures below are test speakers unless marked.

thresholds.rule: most correct accepts on dev with false accepts <= 0.05

random10.description: Per speaker: 10 random list words of 40, 10 other random words as non-list. 1 template per list word, 9 test repeats each; 10 repeats of each non-list word.

random10TwoTemplates.description: Same lists and seed, but 2 templates per list word (8 test repeats each).

digits.description: List = digits zero to nine; non-list = 10 random other words. Test speakers.

digitsAllSpeakersArgmax.description: Closed-set (no rejection) digit accuracy over all 30 speakers; no threshold involved, so dev speakers are fair to include.

whisperComparison.note: Different conditions. Whisper is speaker-independent open-vocabulary transcription (any text can come out; chance is near zero); templates are speaker-dependent, closed-set over 10 list words with the speaker's own registration repeat (chance 10%). Not a like-for-like contest.

english.dataset: Google Speech Commands v0.02 test set; speakers with at least 2 repeats of each of the 10 core words
english.description: List = the 10 core words (yes no up down left right on off stop go). 1 random template per word, every other repeat tested. Non-list: each core word in turn left out of the list (9 templates), plus the speaker's other words from _unknown_. Thresholds are the Arabic dev ones, not retuned.

continuous.description: Synthetic recall recordings: 4-7 of the speaker's list words (repeats other than the template) plus 1-2 non-list words, trimmed, shuffled, joined with 0.3-0.8 s gaps, 0.5 s lead-in. Noise: one real background recording per speaker (Arabic dataset background_noise folder: street, kitchen, boiler and so on) as "their room", mixed at the given SNR into the recall recording and, in the sameRoom conditions, into the template clips too (registration and recall happen minutes apart in the same place). Detection by spot(): energy segmentation then DTW per segment. Each list word is credited once.

english.note: English list is 8 of the 10 core words; non-list words are the other 2.

unionWithWhisper.description: Whisper bench clips (digits and yes/no). Per clip, templates are a different repeat by the same speaker of each word in the closed set (digits 0-9 for digit clips; yes/no for yes/no clips, or yes/no plus the 10 digits as distractors in ynWithDigits). Strict thresholds. Union = Whisper correct OR template accepts the right word. Template false credit = template accepts a wrong word. Whisper's own wrong-word credits are not counted here. Same-session read repeats; in the real check, templates would come from the registration trial.

arabic.note: Thresholds were tuned on 15 of these 30 speakers; testSpeakersOnly excludes them.

english.note: The English test set has few repeats per speaker outside yes/no, so digit clips often have only a few candidate words (see candidateWords); with fewer candidates, rejection is easier and the margin rule behaves differently.
